text: 中国央行：为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年9月24日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展8000亿元MLF操作，期限为1年期。
text_en: PBOC: To maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, on September 24, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct an 80 billion yuan MLF operation with a fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award method, with a term of 1 year.
